source.reader: cryoml.explore.i5_1_ihp_real.parse_mdm (text parsing only; run with python -I)

terminals: source grounded (vs = 0 in every block); id = current into the drain terminal (nMOS > 0, pMOS < 0); inputs vg, vd, vb are node voltages = Vgs, Vds, Vbs

fitted_curves.rule: the Vb = 0 curves only: dc_idvg at its three Vd values (keys idvg@d0..d2, ascending |Vd|), dc_idvd at its five Vg values (idvd@g0..g4) and dc_idvd_vth at its three Vg values (idvd@t0..t2): 11 per DUT and temperature. The body-bias curves (dc_idvg at Vb != 0, dc_idvd_vbmin, dc_idvd_vth_vbmin) are stored in the npz and not used
fitted_curves.note: dc_idvd and dc_idvd_vth gate biases are set per DUT and temperature by the measurement setup (LINVT_VALUE: from a threshold extraction), so their values differ between DUTs; keys are by position

inclusion_rule: frozen from the measured current only (cryoml.pdk2.metric): clean_current (zero the points before the last exact zero), trim the leading points up to the first |I| > 1e-10 A, denominator = mean |I| of the trimmed curve; a curve is included iff the denominator > 3e-7 A (Id-Vd) or > 2e-7 A (Id-Vg). A DUT-temperature with no included curve is dropped (none is)

off_floor.definition: median |id| at the three most-off gate biases of the Vb = 0, lowest-|Vd| Id-Vg curve (Vg = -0.5..-0.4 V nMOS, +0.5..+0.4 V pMOS)
